title: Space Jam
why: The original movie website. Still online, untouched since 1996.

title: Zombo.com
why: A voice welcomes you. Anything is possible. That's the whole site. Turn your sound on.

title: The Million Dollar Homepage
why: A student sold a million pixels at a dollar each to pay for university. The ads are all still there.

title: Wayback Machine
why: Type in any address and see how it looked years ago.

title: One Terabyte of Kilobyte Age
why: Rescued GeoCities homepages, one at a time, shown in the browsers they were made for.

title: Cameron's World
why: Thousands of GeoCities scraps collaged into one endless, glittering page.

title: Neocities
why: Free hand-coded homepages, like GeoCities never left. Browse what people are making.

title: Windows 93
why: A fake operating system full of jokes, glitches, and tiny games.

title: Pointer Pointer
why: Hold your cursor still. It finds a photo of someone pointing right at it.

title: The Useless Web
why: One button. It sends you somewhere delightfully pointless.

title: Radio Garden
why: Spin a globe and listen to live radio from anywhere on Earth.

title: WindowSwap
why: Look out of a stranger's window, somewhere in the world.

title: Patatap
why: Every key is a sound and a shape. Mash your keyboard.

title: Silk
why: Draw glowing, symmetrical silk with your mouse.

title: Koalas to the Max
why: Hover a circle and it splits in four. Keep going until a koala appears.

title: Hacker Typer
why: Type anything. Look like a movie hacker.

title: A Soft Murmur
why: Mix rain, fire, waves, and birds into your own background noise.

title: neal.fun
why: Spend Bill Gates' money, dive to the bottom of the sea, and more.

title: The Evolution of Trust
why: A game that explains, gently, why people trust each other or don't.

title: Lynn Fisher
why: Resize your browser window. The whole site transforms.

title: Bruno Simon
why: A portfolio you explore by driving a tiny car.

title: Robby Leonardi
why: A resume you play like a side-scrolling video game.

title: Maggie Appleton's garden
why: Hand-drawn notes that grow over time instead of a blog.

title: Josh Comeau
why: Every button has a little life in it. Hover everything.

title: Cassie Evans
why: A hand-drawn illustration of her that reacts as you move.

title: Tim Holman
why: Generative art and silly web toys, all made by hand.
